summary: The published Professional Studies independent-model enrollment/reentry closure took effect July 1,2026; this is newly discovered older policy, not a November change. Continuing-eligible 195 monthly/100 ASK/2226 additional-capstone charges are separate from the term-based model. ExcelTrack BSBA uses native 180 quarter credits and 10-week terms;2500 tuition+345 resource fee=2845 per term. A 75% externally assessed ceiling computes to 135 quarter credits, not 135 applicable ACE credits; internalAC assessments may count toward the 45-credit remainder. Article ready; complete applicability, prerequisite/module sequence and assessment maps remain blocked. No historical awards were changed.
